# unifi_system_information (Data Source)

The `unifi_system_information` data source exposes controller-wide system information (version, build, hostname, uptime and device type).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read controller-wide system information.
data "unifi_system_information" "this" {}

output "controller_version" {
  value = data.unifi_system_information.this.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `build` (String) The controller build identifier.
- `hostname` (String) The controller hostname.
- `ip_addrs` (List of String) The controller IP addresses.
- `name` (String) The controller name.
- `previous_version` (String) The previously installed controller version.
- `timezone` (String) The controller timezone.
- `ubnt_device_type` (String) The Ubiquiti device type.
- `udm_version` (String) The UDM firmware version (if applicable).
- `uptime` (Number) The controller uptime in seconds.
- `version` (String) The controller software version.
